text_units.verbatim_text:
Fondaparinux
Anticoagulant
-
Yes (maximum of 10%)
Yes (excreted in rat milk)
Inadequate human data
• use only when benefit outweighs risk
Animal data:
• studies in rats/rabbits: subcutaneous doses up to 10 mg/kg/day in rats (about 32 × RHD based on body surface area) and at subcutaneous doses up to 10 mg/kg/day in rabbits (about 65 × RHD based on body surface area) revealed no evidence of impaired fertility or harm to the foetus
• should not be prescribed to pregnant women unless clearly necessary (see also discussion in section 11)
